request: Track my livestock: for each goat give tag number, breed, birth date, weight in kg each month, vaccination dates, and deworming dates. Warn me 7 days before any vaccine is due and show a monthly weight chart per goat.
ref:
app "Goats" paw mint
table goat tag text, breed text, born date
table weight goat ref goat, kg num 0..200 unit "kg"
table vaccine goat ref goat, name text, due date
table deworm goat ref goat
"Vaccines due in 7 days" count(vaccine, it.due - today <= 7 and it.due >= today) big color if(count(vaccine, it.due - today <= 7 and it.due >= today) > 0, warn, ink)
each vaccine where due - today <= 7 and due >= today sort due
  row card
    it.goat.tag it.name grow
    it.due bold color warn
remind "Vaccine due" at vaccine.due
each goat as g
  stack card gap 1
    g.tag g.breed head
    "Born" g.born "| Last dewormed" last(g.deworm.at) faint
    "Weight by month" faint
    trend g.weight, it.kg
    button "Dewormed today" tap add deworm goat = g
form goat, "Add goat"
form weight, "Log weight"
form vaccine, "Add vaccine"
output:

table goat tag text, kind pick Goat|Dog|Bird|Rabbit|Other = Goat, born date, vaccinated date, degerworm date?
"Vaccines due this month" head

    g.tag bold
    each g.beard as b
      row
        b.kind grow
        b.born faint
        if(b.beard < d, "Due", "Healthy") color if(b.beard < d, bad, muted)

ref:
app "Reading" book plum
table book title text, author text?, status pick Want|Reading|Done = Want, finished date?
state tab text = Reading
row gap 1
  each options book.status
    button it fill if(tab = it, accent, soft) tap set tab = it
state q text = ""
field q "Search titles"
each book where status = tab and has(title, q) sort title as b
  row card tap edit b swipe remove b
    stack grow
      b.title bold
      b.author faint
    if b.status = Reading
      button "Finished" tap set b.status = Done then set b.finished = today
stat count(book where status = Done and finished >= addmonths(today, -12)), "books finished in the last year"

request: Show how much each person paid in total
ref:
app "Split" users ocean
table friend name text
table cost what text, amount money, paid ref friend
let share = sum(cost.amount) / count(friend)
"Total" sum(cost.amount) "," share "each" head
each friend as f
  let bal = sum(f.cost.amount) - share
  row card
    f.name bold grow
    "paid" sum(f.cost.amount) faint
    if(bal >= 0, "gets back", "owes") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
form friend, "Add friend"
form cost, "Add cost"
list cost
